derivation: CHANGELOG 0.3.0 rejects a required replay claim ending after 253402300799 with retention_exceeded before commitment or storage. Use the same created, nonce and method coverage as the replay positive case, changing only expires to 253402300800. The expires wire value is permitted by RFC 9421 Section 3.2.1. The published Appendix B Ed25519 key independently signs the exact method and signature-params base with OpenSSL pkeyutl -sign -rawin; the signature is fixed input, not generated by the consumer.
